name: hadith-dashboard
description: Editorial dashboard for the Open Hadith corpus

scripts.db:init: psql "${STUDIO_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://localhost:5432/hadith_studio}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema.sql && psql "${STUDIO_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://localhost:5432/hadith_studio}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema-entities.sql
scripts.db:setup: createdb hadith_studio 2>/dev/null; psql -d hadith_studio -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema.sql && psql -d hadith_studio -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/schema-entities.sql && node db/seed.mjs
